description.value: Rock City Cycles is a full-service bicycle shop on the Island Highway North in Nanaimo, BC, carrying a broad range of bikes from road and gravel to electric and children's models alongside a full parts and accessories catalog. Touring cyclists will find purpose-built touring stock readily available, including panniers, racks, frame bags, handlebar bags, fenders, and hydration systems. The shop runs a service department and offers Canada-wide parts shipping.
